answer: Locks are entered in summit, expire in atlas, and terrace lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 178 aliases therefore needs 32 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1695 identities would post 1639 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
